name: PT Intiland Development Tbk
summary: PT Intiland Development Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, develops and manages real estate properties in Indonesia. It operates through five segments: Real Estate, Rental of Office Building, Hotels, Industrial Estate, and Facilities. The company engages in residential and apartment development; office space rental; hotel operation; industrial estate development and management; and golf courses, sports club, and related retail facilities management. It is also involved in fitness center; food and refined cuisine; hospitality; and telecommunications infrastructure activities.
